Optional local copies of the two libraries (see the main README, "Optional: work fully offline").

Save these files here with exactly these names:
  chart.umd.min.js  <- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.js
  three.min.js      <- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/build/three.min.js

If they are absent the loader uses public CDNs instead.
